_how: Each node is one stretch of talk. 'say' is a list of text boxes. Then either 'choices' (a menu), 'next' (another node), or nothing (the talk ends). Markup: [red]..[/] [yellow] [blue] [gray] [gold] [shake] [wave], ^1-^9 pauses, \n new line. A line can be {"text": "..", "face": "smile", "speed": 60} to swap to art/marquez-smile.png or type slower. A choice can have "needs": "nodeId" (only shows once that node was heard; "!nodeId" means NOT heard yet) and "once": true (hides after it's been picked).  A line wrapped in (parentheses) is narration: no nameplate, in italics. Faces: smile, angry, point (talk1/talk2 are his mouth moving, used automatically). 'name' is the nameplate; a line or node can set its own \"name\". 'returning' is where he starts for someone who has talked to him before.
